sentences.text:
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 664 of 2022
Applicant :- Mukhtar Ansari

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Lalmani Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Tripathi,J.
Sri Shiv Sagar Singh, Advocate has filed his Vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party nos.2 to 4 in
Court today, which is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for opposite party nos.2 to 4 and learned AGA for the State.

This Transfer Application has been moved by the applicant for transfer of Sessions Trial No.78 of 2021 (State vs. Imtiyaz and others) arising out of Case Crime No.65 of 2020, under Sections 498A,
304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Chandauli, District Chandauli, pending in the court of Additional Sessions Judge/FTC-I Chandauli.
The main submission is that house of opposite party nos.2 to 4 is nearby Chandauli City and applicant comes from Mirzapur.
Opposite parties used to threatened the applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for opposite party nos.2 to 4 objected the transfer application and submitted that PW1-applicant has been examined and cross-examination of PW1 is continued and opposite parties are cooperating in the trial.
The grounds for transfer of the aforesaid case is insufficient and this criminal transfer application lacks merit and is liable to be rejected.
Accordingly, this application is hereby rejected.
Applicant may move an application for protection under Witness Protection Scheme before the court concerned to protect the witness from the court premises to bus stand.

Order Date :- 18.1.2023/Priya  Mukhtar Ansari vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53910755/
